item.title: Output Styles
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: The one extension point that edits the system prompt itself. Five built-in styles, the single frontmatter field that decides whether Claude still behaves like an engineer, and how output styles differ from the four mechanisms they get confused with.
